PHASE 3 CANDIDATE IDEA:
======================================================================

A platform's robots.txt policy reflects its revenue model:

  ATTENTION ECONOMY (ads, subscriptions)
  → Refuse machine readers by name (blocklist)
  → Goal: maximize human eyeballs, hide volume from competitors

  TRANSACTION ECONOMY (APIs, exchanges, fees)
  → Welcome or enumerate machine readers (allowlist/open)
  → Goal: maximize total transaction volume, machines = volume
